$comment: Source of truth for the pivi->yapi rebrand. Drives scripts/apply-rename.mjs (initial rename + future re-runs) and scripts/check-rename.mjs (completeness gate), and guides manual upstream cherry-pick translation. See docs/adr/0001-rebrand-pivi-to-yapi-as-soft-fork.md and CONTEXT.md.

token_rules.disambiguation: Pass 1 matches the full 4-character case-sensitive tokens pivi/Pivi/PIVI. The 2-character engine tokens pi/Pi (PiAgent, PiChatService, engine/pi, @earendil-works/pi-agent-core) are never matched and are preserved unchanged. Pass 2 (Yapi->YaPi) applies only to display surfaces; code identifiers, CSS, JSON keys, and fenced/inline code in markdown are spared.

display_surfaces.description: Where Pass 2 (Yapi->YaPi) applies. Code identifiers and JSON keys keep Yapi; only these display surfaces get the wordmark.

manual_display_surfaces.description: Display surfaces NOT auto-transformed by apply-rename Pass 2 — a blanket Yapi->YaPi would corrupt code identifiers sharing the file (e.g. YapiPluginHost in eslint.config.mjs). Maintain as YaPi by hand; check-rename guards quoted "Yapi" literals against regression.
files: eslint.config.mjs — brands + ignoreWords entries must be "YaPi"
src/**/*.ts, packages/**/*.ts — hardcoded UI literals (getDisplayText, createEl text, throw/Error, Notice, prompt strings, DOM textContent)
packages/**/*.ts — OAuth client_name, callback HTML, tool descriptions

structural_renames.description: Paths moved with git mv. The generator renames ONLY the explicit entries below (directories shallowest-first, then files) — there is no auto-discovery, so every pivi/Pivi-named path in the tree must be listed or it keeps its old name while its contents get renamed (breaking imports). The entry for tests/yapi-react/PiviViewHost.test.ts uses its POST-directory-rename path because directory renames run before file renames.

allowlist.description: Surviving pivi/Pivi/PIVI tokens that are legitimate and must not be renamed by the generator or flagged by check-rename.
allowlist.rationale: file_globs cover documents that reference old names by definition (the rename tooling itself, the glossary/ADR that define the rebrand, the issue specs under .scratch, and the fork-skills profile/skills that carry upstream attribution and are refreshed separately). token_contexts cover upstream-attribution repo names and the rebrand slug that survive inside otherwise-renamed files. file_token_contexts allow the README migration note to name the legacy `.pivi/` data directory (switchers need the old folder name); code is never covered by this.

preserved.description: Tokens intentionally NOT renamed: the Pi engine layer keeps its own name.
